title: Pre-Analysis — Report Correlation Standard Against the Open Domain Hosting Proposal
abstract: Closed work order examining whether the correlation function should stay on the certified terminal or move to the open information domain, delegated to the domain study without a recommendation either way.

sections.objective: Establish whether the report correlation function has to remain hosted on the certified maintenance terminal, or whether it could be moved to the onboard information domain so that the ranking could be improved from the ground without a modification programme. Two operators had supplied a year of raw report data showing that their own route structures would justify a better ranking.
sections.findings_summary: The technical answer is that it could move; the one-way gateway already carries the raw report stream and nothing would have to cross towards the certified side. The question that could not be settled here is whether the terminal would remain the approved means of compliance if the ranked presentation an engineer actually uses lives outside the certified domain. That is an agency question and not an engineering one. Two practical findings came out of the search. The verification task exercises the correlation with an injection sequence and would have to exercise two presentations rather than one, which doubles it. And two ranked lists in the same hangar, one on the terminal and one on a tablet, is a human factors exposure that nobody had named. Neither is a blocker; both belong to whoever owns the domain proposal.
sections.next_steps: Delegate the question to the information domain study without a recommendation. Ask the certification office for an early view on the means of compliance before any design effort is spent. Hold the verification task unchanged.

evidence.similarity_note: Found by entity linking on the interface unit and data concentrator part numbers the task calls out.

expected_findings.rationale: The verification task runs four injection sequences against one presentation. With a second presentation on the open domain it would have to run them against both, or state which one is being verified and why the other need not be.
expected_findings.resolution: Hold unchanged; hand the requirement to the domain study.

evidence.similarity_note: Reached from the modification to its retrofit bulletin.

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin instructs operators to keep the raw list available for six months so that the ranking can be tuned against fleet data. That instruction is the origin of the operator data that prompted the domain proposal, and it should be cited rather than repeated.
expected_findings.resolution: Cite the bulletin instruction in the domain study.

type_data.conclusion: Closed and delegated. The technical route is open; the means of compliance question decides it.
